title: 2026 Crayon Shin-chan Film's Trailer Unveils TOMOO's Theme Song
content: The staff for Eiga Crayon Shin-chan Kikikaikai! Ora no Yōkai Bake-shon (Crayon Shin-chan The Movie Super Strange! My Yōkai Monster Vacation), the 33rd 2D anime film in the Crayon Shin-chan series, presented its full trailer and a new poster visual on Thursday.
author: ANN

title: Shigemitsu Harada, Takumi Kobayashi Launch New Manga
content: Kodansha 's YanMaga Web announced on Monday that Shigemitsu Harada and Takumi Kobayashi will launch a new series together titled Ijime to Kaeru to Mama to Fukushū (Bullying, Frogs, Mama, and Revenge) on the platform on June 18.
author: ANN

title: Daisaku Tsuru's Protocol Ryugu Manga Gets Japanese Serialization
content: Kodansha 's YanMaga Web website announced on Monday that Daisaku Tsuru 's Protocol Ryugu manga will get a Japanese serialization and will launch on the website on June 18. The manga was first featured in the special English issue of Kodansha 's Weekly Young Magazine that was published last year.
author: ANN

title: BAKI-DOU: The Invincible Samurai Part 2 Teases Epic Matchups in Main Trailer, Anime Expo 2026 Panel Announced
content: BAKI-DOU: The Invincible Samurai Part 2 revealed a new trailer, giving a look at the battles coming for Musashi Miyamoto when the series returns to Netflix on June 18. All twelve episodes of the anime will be released at once .
author: Anime Corner

title: Manga UP! Global Adds Handa-kun Manga
content: Manga UP! Global launched on Wednesday Satsuki Yoshino 's Handa-kun manga in English from Yen Press . The company describes the story: Handsome teenage calligrapher Sei Handa is worshipped by all his classmates as an aloof superstar--too bad Sei's inherent negativity makes him believe that everyone actually hates…
author: ANN

title: Netflix’s Avatar: The Last Airbender Addresses Its Huge Aang Problem With Major Timeskip
content: Avatar: The Last Airbender has been facing a huge problem ever since the live-action series was first announced to be in the works with Netflix, and it’s been revealed that those behind the scenes have addressed how much Aang’s actor has grown with a time skip for the new season.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll Streams The Other World's Books Depend on the Bean Counter Anime's OVA
content: Crunchyroll began streaming on Tuesday the original video anime ( OVA ) episode of the television anime of storywriter Yatsuki Weakest and illustrator Kikka Ohashi 's The Other World's Books Depend on the Bean Counter ( Isekai no Sata wa Shachiku Shidai ) boys-love light novel series.
author: ANN

title: Beguiling's BDP Press Licenses Battan's THE GOLDEN FLY Manga for Release in English
content: The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for Canada's The Beguiling comic book store announced on Tuesday that its in-house publisher BDP Press will publish Battan 's THE GOLDEN FLY ( Kinbae) manga in English. The company launched a Kickstarter crowdfunding campaign to help fund the print release of the title.
author: ANN

title: 5 Long Lost Godzilla Villains That We’re Still Waiting to Return
content: Godzilla has been conquering the world across multiple fronts in recent years. In 2026 alone, Apple TV brought back the MonsterVerse in North America thanks to the second season of Monarch: Legacy of Monsters .
author: ComicBook

title: Always a Catch! Anime Casts Kana Hanazawa
content: The staff for the television anime of Mayo Momoyo 's Always a Catch! ( Nigashita Sakana wa Ōkikatta ga Tsuriageta Sakana ga Ōkisugita Ken ) light novel series announced on Wednesday that it has cast Kana Hanazawa as the mysterious woman Zaira, who seems have a grudge against Maria.
author: ANN
